sentences.text: The common crane is a bird with a mass of 5.5 kg and a wingspan of 2.2 m.
Its status is listed as least concern (LC) by the IUCN.
In Mainz-Bingen it has 977 reports over ten years, with peaks in February and between October and December.
It feeds as an omnivore and lives in wetlands.
It is active by day and migrates.
In the wild it can live up to 43 years.
